content: The gearbox ratios you use — 1:2, 1:4 — were not invented by you. Etched inside the first gearbox housing you disassembled, beneath the grease, were markings in a hand that was not yours.
They describe the same ratios. The same torque math. Whoever left them understood kinetic transmission before you were born.
The markings stop mid-equation, as if the author was interrupted. Or as if the rest was taken somewhere else.
title: The Etched Ratios
